mails_kind.name: mails_kind
mails_kind.value:
case when "mails"."category" = 'player'
        then "mails"."subject" is not null and "mails"."body" is not null and "mails"."template_key" is null and "mails"."params" is null
        else "mails"."sender_id" is null and "mails"."subject" is null and "mails"."body" is null and "mails"."template_key" is not null and "mails"."params" is not null end

mails_lengths.name: mails_lengths
mails_lengths.value: char_length("mails"."subject") between 1 and 20 and char_length("mails"."body") between 1 and 200 and char_length("mails"."template_key") between 1 and 100

single_gate_auto.name: single_gate_auto
single_gate_auto.value: "single_gate"."mode" between 0 and 2 and "single_gate"."exp_bonus" >= 0 and "single_gate"."auto_runs_left" between 0 and "single_gate"."auto_runs_bought" and "single_gate"."auto_runs_bought" between 0 and 3 and "single_gate"."auto_end_floor" between 1 and 170 and "single_gate"."auto_reach_floor" between 1 and 170
